accent.$description: One accent per product (hub D-90), the only value that varies between products, and the colour of its doll (hub D-101). Each is at least 4.5:1 on the page in its theme.

forspring.$description: Forspring and the account: buttons, links and focus. Its doll is ink, not this blue (hub D-101, role.mark). Dark replaces the account's #4D68FF, which is 4.23:1 on the dark ground.

spring.$description: Spring (BrainSpring is part of it): Forspring's blue, one blue for the suite (hub D-101), and its doll is blue, as its Slack avatar.

dataspring.$description: DataSpring, deep teal. Light was #0b7c82 until 0.10.1: 4.39:1 on the soft grey (brand review 2026-11-11), so it was darkened by the least that passes, 0.7 apart in OKLab x100, too little to see (D-20). #0b7a7f until 0.27.0: the soft grey moved to stay 0.03 L under the grey page, and the teal was darkened by the least that keeps 4.5:1 on it (#01767c, 4.56:1, hue within 1 degree, D-41).

appspring.$description: AppSpring, violet (hub D-116). Plum #7b3f8c / #b57cc6 until 0.10.2, 8.8 and 7.7 from PulseSpring's magenta (D-21).

flowspring.$description: FlowSpring, moss (hub D-120). Light #3d4900 is 8.24:1 on the worst surface with a white label at 9.76:1; dark #9fab02 is 6.27:1 with a #111215 label at 7.40:1. At least 10 from every status and signal in both themes (test/contrast.test.ts, "FlowSpring's moss stays 10 from every status and signal"). Beside it a status is always a labelled pill, never a dot or a tint alone (brand/README, D-43).

pulsespring.$description: PulseSpring, magenta: green would blur with the success status in a monitoring product.
